question: Which mountain was climbed by the joint Nepal-India expedition in May 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Mt Kanchanjungha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Mt. Kanchanjungha joint expedition gives new heights to Nepal-India relations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Summit Dates:** **May 19–20, 2025**

 
 
• 
 
**Team:** **15 members** (10 from **Nepali Army**, 5 from **Indian Army**)

 
 
• 
 
**Flag-off Ceremony:** Held on **April 3, 2025**, in presence of **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh**

 
 
• 
 
**Flag Handed Over To:** **Nepal’s Defence Minister Man Bir Rai** and **Chief of General Staff Nirmal Thapa**

 
 
• 
 
**First Joint Climb** of **Mt Kanchanjungha** by the two armies

 
 
• 
 
Earlier joint summits of **Sagarmatha (Mt Everest)** in **2003** and **2013**
